title: Post-correction cadence restart fires for EVERY post-correction batch — all later batches mislabel as invitation_sent
detail: After the reset, batch_index becomes 1; every later batch still compares Gt against corrected_ts and 1 > 0, so the reset re-fires indefinitely. A corrected row's co-nudge and reminders all become duplicate "invitation_sent" entries with empty detail — contradicting the comment's "first batch" claim.
recommended_fix: Carry a reset flag (or first-post-correction position) in the fold state so only the first batch after corrected_ts restarts at 0; subsequent batches continue co_nudge/reminder_sent. Extend the restart test with a second post-correction batch.

title: terminalized_at stamps on the refused/objected and failed writer paths are asserted by no test in this diff
evidence:
diff --git a/server/src/reference_checks/sql/terminalize_reference_call.sql
@@ -21,6 +21,7 @@ SET status          = $2::reference_call_status,
     terminal_reason = COALESCE(NULLIF($4, ''), terminal_reason),
     result          = $5::jsonb,
     next_attempt_at = NULL,
+    terminalized_at = now(),

   terminalized_at_is_set(db, row_id) |> should.be_true

  text_column(db, token, "terminalized_at IS NOT NULL")
  |> should.equal("true")
detail: The diff pins terminalized_at only for the T+144 sweep terminal and the form_completed path, plus substituted_at for substitution. terminalize_reference_call (refused/objected) and sweep_mark_failed (failed) gain the stamp with no assertion — a dropped stamp there ships silently.
recommended_fix: Add integration assertions that refused, objected, and failed terminalizations leave terminalized_at set, matching the pinned coverage the other three writers already have.
